title: The Joining the Circle Late
youtube_title: The Joining the Circle Late | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Trying the smallest brave step still counts.
summary: At a bakery counter facing the street, Nim feels shy about a circle that could still open if you stepped in. Instead of pretending not to care, Nim tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while the ferryman stays kind and does not push for a show.
